description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Wennappuwa, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District (25/0082)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration under the Registration of Title Act. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" and contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, extents, and encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
